[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
The captured profile states that Jean was born in 1626. No birth source supports that year; retain it only as an unproved estimate. Her actual birth is not established. 
== Research Notes ==
=== Selected uncertain Linlithgow family — 16 October 2026 ===

Select John [[Glasgow-1561]] as the uncertain working father of Jean [[Glasgow-3083]], the mother named in the 1654 Issobell Glen baptism citation. The existing Linlithgow father study places an indexed daughter Jean in John’s household in 1613, represented by [[Glasgow-3055]]. The later mother’s profile also places her in Linlithgow. A child baptised in 1613 could have been a mother in 1654, about 41 years later if baptised in infancy. The 1626 birth stated for the later mother has no identified birth source and is not a concrete conflict with that identity. Prefer the possible same-woman explanation and carry the existing father comparison to the adult account, at low confidence. This is a selected inference from the existing local family and chronology, not a parent named in the 1654 citation.

The profiles [[Glasgow-3055]] and [[Glasgow-3083]] remain separate accounts of a possible single woman. The selection establishes neither two distinct daughters called Jean nor a completed identity merge. The 1613 daughter’s later whereabouts are not established. Another Jean in another Glasgow household remains possible; a later daughter in John’s wider family is another explanation. The 1654 citation identifies Jean Glasgow as Issobell Glen’s mother, but its full event fields and original page have not been re-read here. Linlithgow for the adult account comes from her existing profile field, not a newly verified place clause in that baptism. Age 41 assumes baptism near birth and is an illustrative compatibility check, not a recorded maternal age. The 1626 profile year stays an unproved estimate; do not silently replace it with a proved 1613 birth. The saved accounts give 7 and 17 July 1613 and cite both X1RX-HPY and X1RX-HPB; retain these literal differences pending the original register. They are not counted as independent corroborating events. No mother, marriage date, husband’s given name or new child profile is inferred. John’s own selected Andrew-of-Calder father remains uncertain and is not proved by Andrew’s testament. No new original inspection, certain relationship upgrade, live WikiTree edit or identity merge is claimed. Connectivity continues to count profile accounts and therefore does not resolve this possible duplicate. <ref>FamilySearch, Scotland Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950: [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X1RX-GHZ Jean Glasgow in Issobell Glen entry, 1654]; [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X1RX-HPY Jean Glesgow, 1613]; [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X1RX-HPB source cited for the 1613 daughter in John’s maintained review]. Existing citations, not new original inspections; date and reference differences remain to be reconciled.</ref>

A possible identification concerns Jean Glasgow. The banns/marriage index records Jeane Glasgow and Robert Aliesone on 28 May 1652 at St Monance.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 454/10 / 169; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.

A possible identification concerns Jean Glasgow. The printed Edinburgh marriage register records Jean Glasgow with William Mitchell, merchant, on 16 December 1675.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 685 / 1/440 / 164; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record]; Henry Paton, ed., Register of Marriages for the Parish of Edinburgh, 1595–1700 (Scottish Record Society, 1905), printed pp.267 and 481; PDF pp.277 and 491; [https://electricscotland.com/history/records/scottishrecordso16scotuoft.pdf#page=491 record]; Same edition, unnumbered Prefatory Note, PDF p.9; [https://electricscotland.com/history/records/scottishrecordso16scotuoft.pdf#page=9 record].</ref> The printed transcription and its preface were visually inspected on 30 September 2026; original parish image unchecked. The identification remains uncertain.

A possible identification concerns Jean Glasgow. The banns/marriage index records Jean Glasgow and Robert Woodsyd on 13 January 1700 at West Kilbride.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 620/20 / 77; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. Jean Glasgow/Robert Woodsyd 1700 has no compatible proven pair; [[Woodside-936]] was born 1696. The identification remains uncertain.
